create_RMSNorm_layer: create an RMSNorm layer with a specified number of features for normalizing tensor inputs
build_RMSNorm_with_affine: build an RMSNorm layer with learnable affine weight parameters initialized to 1.0
test_RMSNorm_forward: test the RMSNorm forward pass by normalizing a tensor using root mean square normalization
refactor_RMSNorm_eps: refactor the RMSNorm layer to use a custom epsilon value for numerical stability
review_RMSNorm_reset_parameters: review the RMSNorm reset_parameters method that initializes affine weights to constant 1.0
